ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) field with approximately 8-10% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage localized to surface scarring and markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation with high-contrast linear streaks concentrated on the right lobe and small circular clusters scattered near the central notch and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an estimated internal angle of 105 degrees at the central convergence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Frequent, low-amplitude serrations across the continuous boundary; notable high-amplitude irregular profile on the outer margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature transitioning to a straight taper toward the acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete clusters of roughly circular high-intensity pixels (3-10 pixel diameter) visible on the lobe tips and mid-surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Densely packed, unaligned white linear pixel segments (rake marks) primarily oriented diagonally across the right ventral lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant linear rake mark network across both lobes; irregular jaggedness on the distal left tip suggesting historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Concentrated white punctate speckling observed near the central peduncle attachment point.
